profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, traded under the ticker CDNS. According to its own site, it is an EDA and Intelligent System Design provider that delivers hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The company describes itself as a leading provider in that field, and also presents itself as a great company, citing its culture, a Fortune 100 Great Places to Work listing, and investment in sustainability.

The material available on its AI products and position is thin. No products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are listed. Its site language centers on computational software for intelligent system design rather than on named AI offerings.

The held record adds a few structural facts: the company is a for-profit public company with CIK 0000813672, and it appears in California law exposure records with a count of 281. No lawsuits are recorded.
